source_review.notes: Checked all 10 structured references against current official PostgreSQL, Google Cloud BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Materialize, Apache Flink, Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Oracle, and Microsoft documentation; every final URL returned HTTP 200. Verified current full/incremental refresh, dynamic-table, change-feed, rewrite, stored-result, maintenance and platform-limitation claims in their stated scopes; no product behavior is generalized into a universal materialization guarantee.

evidence: Checked source/definition/materialization equality, signed-multiset deltas, grouped sum retractions, average components, distinct multiplicity, comparable progress positions, and generation states plus balanced GitHub math delimiters.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Notation separates semantic equality, change algebra, auxiliary state, progress, publication and lifecycle.

Recomputed Exercise 2 states: initial (sum 60,count 3,avg 20,min 10,max 30,distinct 3); after changes (90,3,30,10,50,3), (80,2,40,30,50,2), (110,3,110/3,30,50,2), then (80,2,40,30,50,2).
numerical_recomputation.notes: Update and deletion retractions, duplicate multiplicity, sum/count average and min/max transitions are numerically consistent.

evidence: Expanded incremental maintenance as prior view plus equivalent delta for insertions/retractions and verified update, filter-transition, grouped aggregate and distinct-multiplicity cases.

Verified per-key induction preserves equality only with complete captured changes, sufficient prior state, idempotency/version order, supported deterministic delta rules and common-boundary reconciliation.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: Cross-key atomicity, missing before-images, non-monotone auxiliary state and incomplete oracles remain explicit limits.

evidence: Reviewed insert/update/delete, predicate crossings, duplicates, out-of-order versions, late corrections, timestamp ties, partial/overlapping runs, partition replacement, join multiplicity, temporal dimensions, distinct/min/max retractions and nondeterminism.
Reviewed build/catch-up gaps, atomic swap, stale rollback, tombstone resurrection, policy/schema changes, multi-source boundaries, query rewrite, cache, restore, retirement and sensitive aggregates.
boundary_and_adversarial_cases.notes: Adversarial analysis covers algebraic, temporal, concurrency, operational, security, recovery and lifecycle boundaries.

evidence: Traced stable identity/grain/key, versioned definition/source boundary, durable progress, correct retractions, idempotent ordered refresh, atomic publication, pinned reconciliation, policy and retirement through exposition, examples and answers.
invariant_checking.notes: No target maximum, successful run, watermark, row count, automatic feature, current-source rebuild or aggregate label is treated as broader proof than it supplies.

evidence: Reviewed incremental correctness by induction over ordered source transitions and atomic publication by resolution before/after one immutable generation-pointer change.
proof_review.notes: Complete capture, equivalent delta rules, reconciliation, immutable generation lifetime and one-pointer reader resolution are explicit assumptions; multi-table/client paths require more coordination.

evidence: Incremental-correctness and atomic-publication statements and arguments are explicitly labeled claims and proof sketches with immediate counterconditions.
The executable is labeled a per-key illustration and disclaims complete delivery, cross-key atomicity and production recovery.
proof_sketch_labeling.notes: Formal properties, deterministic fixture, empirical reconciliation, current platform behavior and policy decisions remain distinct.

evidence: Current platform mechanisms and restrictions are attributed to named official sources.
Plans, watermarks, job outcomes, source/target versions, reconciliation, fault tests, usage and cost are presented as scoped evidence rather than universal correctness.
empirical_evidence_labeling.notes: Managed automation does not become an ownership or assurance claim; every conclusion stays bounded by definition, boundary and tested change model.

conceptual_review.notes: Reviewed end to end. The chapter coherently connects materialization value to versioned source/definition equality, delta algebra, joins and aggregates, full/partition/incremental modes, progress, atomic publication, backfill/cutover, reconciliation, evolution, managed semantics, governance and retirement.
